rules: Courier imports need the consignee's CNIC (and NTN for commercial quantities); the courier files the clearance on your behalf.
Cargo (air freight / sea) shipments require a Goods Declaration on WeBOC / Pakistan Single Window, usually via a licensed customs agent.
Customs may re-assess value using Valuation Rulings for auto parts; duty is charged on the higher of declared and ruling value.
Import of USED auto parts is restricted under the Import Policy Order; check the current IPO schedule before ordering used parts commercially.
Personal-use quantities only via courier; multiple identical parts may be treated as commercial import.
Keep the seller's invoice and payment proof (bank / card statement); customs can ask for it to accept declared value.
